name: icon-tile
title: Icon Tile
description: A rounded-square tile holding an icon or logo on a contrast-checked tint or the brand fill.

examples.name: icon-tile-sizes
examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: sm, md and lg, soft and solid.

examples.name: icon-tile-tints
examples.title: Tints
examples.description: Every tint: solid, brand, accent, info, success, warning, danger, none.

examples.name: icon-tile-list
examples.title: In a list
examples.description: tint="auto" gives each account a stable colour from its name.

examples.name: icon-tile-image
examples.title: Logo image
examples.description: An img with alt text; neutral face by default, or on a tint.

props.name: children
props.description: An icon from @syntara/icons. Sized to half the tile at the brand's icon stroke.

props.name: src
props.description: An image (asset or merchant logo) instead of an icon.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible name. With src it's the image's alt; without, the tile gets role="img". Omit it (and aria-label) when a visible label sits next to the tile: the tile is then aria-hidden.

props.name: tint
props.description: solid = action.primary pair; tones = the same engine-checked bg/fg pairs as Avatar; auto = a stable tint from a hash of name (same hash as Avatar).

props.name: name
props.description: Seed for tint="auto" (falls back to alt).

notes: Decorative by default (aria-hidden), because a tile usually sits next to its label. Give it alt or aria-label when it stands alone.
Every tint is a pair the engine checks at 4.5:1 in both schemes; icons only need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).
Not interactive. To make it clickable, put it inside a Button or Link, which carries the name and focus ring.

do: Use tint="auto" with a name for lists of assets or accounts, so each keeps its colour.
Use solid for one hero mark (the brand logo, a feature card).
dont: Don't use tints to carry status on their own; pair them with text.
Don't put text or numbers in a tile; use Avatar for initials.

typeNotes.note: There is no 'neutral' tint (Badge's tone has one). The quiet, uncoloured tile is 'none'. The type is IconTileTint, exported from @syntara/react.
